# Canadian Citizenship Quiz

> Free practice for the Canadian citizenship test (20 questions, 45 minutes, 15 correct answers to pass, as published by IRCC), with every answer explained, in English and in Canadian French, plus a day-by-day count of the 1,095 days of physical presence, IRCC fees and each step from the application to the oath. Independent site published by Radif Partners, not IRCC. Questions written from the facts of Discover Canada; rules and fees read on canada.ca and dated in one parameter file.

## Pages in English

- [CLB calculator: TEF Canada, TCF and CELPIP to CRS points](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/): CLB calculator for TEF Canada, TCF Canada, CELPIP, IELTS General and PTE Core: each skill to CLB/NCLC, then Express Entry points, with free practice in French.
- [Radif Partners: who publishes these TEF and CLB tools](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/about/): Who publishes the TEF Canada, TCF Canada and CELPIP converters and practice on this site, where every chart comes from, and what the site never sells or does.
- [CELPIP to CLB: how IRCC reads each level, with points](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/celpip-clb/): CELPIP to CLB as IRCC applies it: each CELPIP-General level equals the same CLB, the minimum for each program, citizenship and the points each level earns.
- [CELPIP listening practice: English audio from CLB 4 to 10](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/celpip-listening-practice/): CELPIP listening practice: short English conversations and announcements read by your browser, graded from CLB 4 to 10, with the transcript after each answer.
- [CELPIP practice test for reading: CLB 4 to 10 questions](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/celpip-reading-practice/): CELPIP reading practice: English reading questions sorted by CLB level, from 4 to 10, corrected at once, to see where you stand before booking the CELPIP.
- [CELPIP vs IELTS General: scores for CLB 7 and CLB 9 compared](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/celpip-vs-ielts/): CELPIP vs IELTS General Training, with PTE Core: the score each test needs for CLB 7 and CLB 9 per skill, what IRCC accepts, and the thresholds for citizenship.
- [Citizenship language test: CLB 4 results IRCC accepts](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/citizenship-language-test/): Citizenship language test: who must prove CLB 4, the listening and speaking results IRCC accepts per test, TEF and TCF at B1, why expired results count.
- [CLB 7 score on every test: TEF, TCF, CELPIP, IELTS, PTE](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/clb-7/): CLB 7 and NCLC 7 on each test IRCC accepts: the minimum score per skill for TEF Canada, TCF Canada, CELPIP, IELTS and PTE Core, and why this level matters most.
- [CRS language points: first, second language and spouse](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/crs-language-points/): CRS language points from your CLB or NCLC levels: first official language, second language, spouse, transferability with education and work, French bonus.
- [Express Entry French bonus: CRS points and NCLC 7 scores](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/express-entry-french-bonus/): Express Entry French bonus: who earns the extra CRS points, why English CLB 5 doubles them, the TEF and TCF scores for NCLC 7, and the French-language category.
- [Residence card French level: A2 and B1 required in 2026](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/france-residence-card-french/): French level for a residence card in France since 1 January 2026: A2 for a first multi-year card, B1 for a first resident card, recognised tests, scores.
- [Naturalisation B2 French level: tests, diplomas, exemptions](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/french-naturalisation-b2/): Naturalisation in France now asks B2 French: diplomas that prove it, test conditions set by the 2025 order, who is exempt, and the TEF and TCF scores for B2.
- [IELTS General Training to CLB: 2026 band chart from IRCC](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/ielts-general-clb/): IELTS General Training to CLB with the IRCC chart: the band per skill from CLB 4 to 10, why listening asks more, citizenship bands and Express Entry points.
- [Language test validity: how long TEF and TCF results count](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/language-test-validity/): Language test validity for Express Entry and citizenship: the two-year rule, the two dates IRCC checks, expired results for citizenship, and your own end date.
- [Score conversion method: IRCC charts, CRS points, practice](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/method/): How this site converts TEF Canada, TCF Canada, CELPIP, IELTS and PTE Core scores to CLB, counts language points, dates results and writes practice questions.
- [Practice review: retry missed TEF, TCF, CELPIP questions](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/practice-review/): Practice review for TEF, TCF and CELPIP: your results per bank and every missed question, to answer again until right. Kept in your browser, never sent.
- [TCF Canada practice test: timed reading and listening](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/tcf-canada-practice-test/): TCF Canada practice test with a timed reading section and a timed listening section, official count and duration, four options, easy to hard, marked at the end.
- [TCF Canada score to NCLC: 2026 IRCC chart, skill by skill](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/tcf-canada-score/): TCF Canada score to NCLC with the IRCC chart: convert reading, listening and the writing and speaking marks, then see each NCLC and your Express Entry points.
- [TCF Canada test: four tests, timing, marking and results](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/tcf-canada/): TCF Canada test in detail: four compulsory tests, the three writing and speaking tasks, word ranges, the two marking scales, result delays and retake rules.
- [TCF IRN: residence card levels and how the TCF is scored](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/tcf-irn/): TCF IRN for French residence cards and naturalisation: levels required since 2026, how the TCF manual scores the test, CEFR bands and what remains unconfirmed.
- [TCF or TEF Canada: format, marking and retakes compared](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/tcf-or-tef/): TCF or TEF Canada for Express Entry: question counts, timing, writing and speaking tasks, marking, result delays, the wait before a retake and sample prices.
- [TEF Canada practice test: timed reading and listening mock](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/tef-canada-practice-test/): TEF Canada practice test: a timed reading section and a timed listening section with the official question count and duration, marked at the end as in the exam.
- [TEF Canada score to NCLC: 2026 chart for all four skills](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/tef-canada-score/): TEF Canada score to NCLC with the IRCC and CCI charts: pick your test date, type the four scores and see the NCLC per skill and your Express Entry points.
- [TEF Canada test: format, timing, results and validity](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/tef-canada/): TEF Canada test explained: four timed tests, the listening and speaking option for citizenship, how scores are set, result delays, fees and the 2-year rule.
- [TEF IRN: format, overall level rule and results for France](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/tef-irn/): TEF IRN explained: the four tests and their timing, how the CCI sets the overall level from A1 to B2, what each French residence card asks, results, validity.
- [TEF and TCF Canada cost: fees by centre and full budget](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/tef-tcf-canada-cost/): TEF Canada and TCF Canada cost: example fees read on centre pages, the citizenship option, retakes, a second language test and travel, added up in one budget.
- [TEF and TCF score to CEFR level: A1 to C2 conversion table](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/tef-tcf-cefr-level/): TEF and TCF score to CEFR level: CCI and France Éducation international bands from A1 to C2, the TCF marks out of 20 and the level each French procedure asks.
- [TEF and TCF listening practice: French audio, A1 to C2](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/tef-tcf-listening-practice/): TEF and TCF listening practice: short French messages and dialogues read aloud by your browser, four options per question, levels A1 to C2, transcript after.
- [TEF and TCF preparation: a plan from target to test day](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/tef-tcf-preparation/): TEF and TCF preparation: set your NCLC target, check your level, split your weekly hours across the four skills and train under exam timing before you book.
- [TEF and TCF reading practice: French questions A1 to C2](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/tef-tcf-reading-practice/): TEF and TCF reading practice in French: short documents and questions from A1 to C2, sorted by level and theme, corrected at once with a clear explanation.
- [TEF and TCF registration: right version, centre and date](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/tef-tcf-registration/): TEF and TCF registration for Canada: which version IRCC accepts, where the centres are listed, the conditions to check and a test date that fits your deadline.
- [TEF and TCF results: delays, appeals and when to retake](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/tef-tcf-results-retake/): TEF and TCF results: when the scores arrive, how they are calculated, the appeal window for the TEF, and how long to wait before sitting the same test again.
- [TEF and TCF speaking practice: oral tasks with a timer](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/tef-tcf-speaking-practice/): TEF and TCF speaking practice: each oral task with a subject, a timer that includes preparation time and a self-check list, to rehearse alone before the exam.
- [TEF and TCF writing practice: timed tasks and word counter](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/tef-tcf-writing-practice/): TEF and TCF writing practice: the official tasks with a subject, a timer, a live word counter set to the expected length and a checklist. Nothing is saved.
- [CLB level needed by program: Express Entry, citizenship](https://ca-tef-tcf-canada.example/en/which-clb-level/): CLB and NCLC level needed for each Express Entry program, the French category and citizenship, plus the CEFR level France asks for residence and naturalisation.
